product.name: Beech cutting board
product.description: The board is beech, edge grain, with a juice groove.

blocks.text: No packing line is added. Felt pads at $14.77 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
The tag on Beech cutting board was $73.80.
The amount to be billed is ninety seven dollars and seventy three cents.

trick.evidence_text: Charged figure ninety seven dollars and seventy three cents.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is ninety seven dollars and seventy three cents and the tag was $73.80. Refuse the higher figure.
